headline: Coris Bank Côte d'Ivoire opens 20% of its capital to the public
summary: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire launched a public share sale of 20% of its capital worth 62.74 billion FCFA, with subscriptions from November 30 to December 4, 2026.
why: Coris Bank is a West African lender, and public share offerings give investors access to banking assets in the regional market.
original_headline: Coris Bank Côte d’Ivoire ouvre 20 % de son capital au public
